phase3_findings.description: In tests/unit/test_factory_wiring.py the three new prompt assertions build their user with a hand-written group string, User(id="anyone", group_memberships=["default"]) on line 265, instead of importing the DEFAULT_USER_GROUP constant that sqllens.agent.factory defines and passes as access. The value matches today, so the tests are sound as shipped. If that constant's value ever changes, get_available_tools would return an empty schema list, and the two assertions that check "TEXT MEMORY" is absent from the prompt would then pass against an empty prompt rather than against a prompt proven to lack the section.
